notes.title: Game Update v1.09
notes.content:
[b]Problem that chests don't open is fixed.[/b]


We are sorry for being late for technical reasons.

notes.title: Game Update v1.08
notes.content:
The durability of the equipment has been increased
Camp fire burning time increased
Hunger, thirst and happiness were balanced

notes.title: Game Update v1.07
notes.content:
Wild horse added as a mount.

Chill effect has been added.

All build errors are fixed.

Spider damage balanced.

notes.title: Game Update v1.06
notes.content:
Fixed the issue where killed wolves in the desert were not saving.

Hunger, thirst, happiness and temperature stats balanced.

[b][u]NOTE:[/u][/b]

[b]We are working on different language options.[/b]

notes.title: Game Update v1.05
notes.content:
The item order in the craft menu has been adjusted.

Fixed getting stuck under house deck, shelter, hut and House Top structures.

Fixed the issue where spiders could gather in one place.

Fixed the issue where structures disappear after load last.

Fixed the issue where the golems did not attack.

[u][b]NOTE:[/b][/u] We are sorry for those who have spiders clumping problem, they need to start a new game with this update.  Those who do not have this problem can continue playing by saying load last right after saying New Game.

notes.title: Game Update v1.04
notes.content:
Grass stacking problem fixed.

Fixed the issue where the teleport disappeared after the game was saved.

Firepit lighting issue fixed.

notes.title: Game Update v1.03
notes.content:
The durability of the stone axe and stone pickaxe has been adjusted.

Life and happiness are renewed faster while sleeping.

The bug that caused it to get dark at night has been fixed.

notes.title: Game Update v1.02
notes.content:
The issue of falling off the map has been fixed.
Fixed the issue where load last was not loaded.
Hunger reduction balanced.
Spider tracking distance balanced.
The issue of stucking under the shelter has been fixed.

We are aware of the problem of not getting dark at night, we are working on it.

notes.title: Game Update
notes.content: The load last black screen error has been fixed.
